changedSections.question: Two metals both show no visible cold-water reaction. Can that alone rank them? Contrast magnesium’s steam product with the hydroxide pattern of suitable cold-water metals.
Write iron with dilute HCl and name the salt oxidation state. Does copper simply evolve hydrogen more slowly? Why might an aluminium surface delay reaction?
In a suitable zinc/CuSO₄ model, identify actual reacting species, product and spectator. Is Zn²⁺ + Cu → Zn + Cu²⁺ established merely because it balances?
Balance aluminium reducing CuO under supplied suitable conditions and name the oxide reduced. Does merely mixing cold solids guarantee this reaction?
Give all eleven required metals in descending order, retaining lithium/calcium, magnesium/aluminium and silver/gold positions. Is carbon one of these metals?
An iron sample is in ordinary water with no visible air above it. Does this guarantee oxygen exclusion? Are salt and an instant brown observation necessary for rusting?
A dry-air control merely omits liquid, and a boiled-water control remains open. Explain how both controls can fail and name two conditions to keep comparable.
Scratched painted iron and intact painted iron are exposed to moisture. Explain local protection and why paint need not supply electrons or change iron’s series position.
Compare connected zinc with a separate zinc piece near wet iron. Write zinc oxidation and explain why copper is unsuitable as its sacrificial replacement.
For CuO + H₂ → Cu + H₂O, assign oxidation/reduction and explain why heatingCuCO₃ alone is not automatically oxidation.
Write and combine zinc oxidation and copper-ion reduction. Why do electrons and sulfate not remain as new products in the net equation?
Identify both agents in zinc with Cu²⁺ and state each agent’s own change. Why is copper metal product or sulfate not the oxidizing agent?
